userStories.title: Certificate & Statutory Compliance Administration API
userStories.description: Implement administrative certificate endpoints supporting full CRUD, validity date tracking, 60-day renewal status computation, public trust visibility toggles, display sequence reordering, and audit logging
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/admin/certificates returns all certificates with computed validity status (valid, expiring_soon, expired, permanent), days remaining, and renewal alert flags
GET /api/v1/admin/certificates/:id returns certificate detail with document attachments (PDF, logo/scanned image) and legal scope
POST /api/v1/admin/certificates creates a new certificate with number, authority, dates, document URLs, and audit log
PUT /api/v1/admin/certificates/:id updates certificate fields and audit log
DELETE /api/v1/admin/certificates/:id soft-deletes certificate (isActive: false) with audit log
PATCH /api/v1/admin/certificates/:id/toggle-public toggles presence on the public /quality page accreditation grid and homepage trust marks
PATCH /api/v1/admin/certificates/reorder reorders display sequence across certificates
RBAC strictly restricts certificate creation, editing, and deletion to admin and editor roles

userStories.title: Certificates & Compliance Desk UI with Document Vault Drawer
userStories.description: Build complete Certificates & Compliance page using DataTable, FilterBar, and AdminDrawer with document inspector and renewal alert banner
acceptanceCriteria: Certificates page renders with DataTable, FilterBar, and AdminStatusBadge components
Top metric strip displays Total Certificates, Publicly Verified, Perpetual Licenses, and Active Renewal Alerts
Renewal alert banner surfaces any credential expiring within 60 days with direct renew action
Table displays Authority/Certificate Name, Registration Number, Issuing Body, Validity Status, Public Visibility toggle, and Actions
Detail drawer features 3 focused tabs: 1) Credentials & Authority, 2) Validity & Renewal Schedule, 3) Document Vault & Trust Display

userStories.title: Automated Certificate Test Coverage & Zero Public Regression
userStories.description: Verify certificate administration features with integration tests and confirm zero public site regression
acceptanceCriteria: Admin API client in client/src/admin/api.js provides fetchAdminCertificates, fetchAdminCertificateById, createAdminCertificate, updateAdminCertificate, deleteAdminCertificate, toggleAdminCertificatePublic, and reorderAdminCertificates
Automated integration tests in server/tests/certificate-admin.test.js cover certificate CRUD, validity calculation, 60-day renewal alert flags, public toggle, and RBAC security
All client and server test suites pass with 100% success
Zero visual regression on public site verified via verify:no-change
